digest.component_or_area: blame resolver and caused_by link backfill
propositions: A one-time backfill script must retroactively draw caused_by links on closed bugs by reusing the conservative single-culprit blame resolver without introducing new heuristics.
The backfill script must be idempotent by checking for existing active caused_by edges via _is_active_link before writing, skipping bugs that already carry the link.
The script must operate in dry-run mode by default for safety; --write mode must be explicitly opted into to perform writes.
The script must link only single-culprit closed bugs and skip ambiguous bugs (those without a high-confidence unique culprit).
A second run of the script in write mode over the same closed bugs must produce zero new links because existing caused_by edges prevent re-writes.
